title: Support probability from algebraic degree
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers, and let $f:\\mathbb F_2^n\\to\\mathbb F_2$ be nonzero with algebraic degree at most $k$. Under the uniform distribution on $\\mathbb F_2^n$, the probability that $f$ is nonzero is at least $2^{-k}$.
hypotheses_covered: the algebraic degree of $f$ is at most $k$
